pipe_stage.title: Open pipeline by team
pipe_stage.description: Open EMEA opportunities closing this or next quarter, by owner role, manager, type, stage and rep forecast category, in incremental ARR (USD). Commit and best case come from the rep forecast category: the rep commit and best-case ARR fields stopped being maintained on 1 Sep 2026 and are being removed.

args.q: SELECT Owner.UserRole.Name role, Owner.Manager.Name manager, RecordType.Name recordType, StageName stage, Rep_Forecast_Category__c forecast, FISCAL_YEAR(CloseDate) fy, FISCAL_QUARTER(CloseDate) fq, COUNT(Id) opps, SUM(Finance_ARR_USD__c) arrUsd FROM Opportunity WHERE IsClosed = false AND (CloseDate = THIS_FISCAL_QUARTER OR CloseDate = NEXT_FISCAL_QUARTER) AND Owner.UserRole.Name IN ('AE-EMEA-FR','AE-EMEA-DACH','AE-EMEA-SOUTH','AE-EMEA-CEE','AE-EMEA-BENELUX','AE-EMEA-MEA','AE-EMEA-IBERIA-LATAM','AE-EMEA-NORDICS','SMB-EMEA','EM-EMEA','EM-EMEA-LATAM','BDR-EMEA','DIR-SALES-EMEA','MGR-SALES-EMEA','VP-SALES-EMEA','DIR-EM-EMEA','DIR-BDR-EMEA') GROUP BY Owner.UserRole.Name, Owner.Manager.Name, RecordType.Name, StageName, Rep_Forecast_Category__c, FISCAL_YEAR(CloseDate), FISCAL_QUARTER(CloseDate) ORDER BY Owner.UserRole.Name, Owner.Manager.Name LIMIT 2000

pipe_partner.title: Pipeline owned outside EMEA sales
pipe_partner.description: Open opportunities on EMEA-region accounts (the account's sales region) whose owner isn't in an EMEA sales role (the global partnership roles, strategic AEs, other regions' sellers, users with no role), so they are in no EMEA team's totals: by owner role, account region, type and close quarter, in incremental ARR (USD).

args.q: SELECT Owner.UserRole.Name role, Account.Sales_Region__c region, RecordType.Name rt, FISCAL_YEAR(CloseDate) fy, FISCAL_QUARTER(CloseDate) fq, COUNT(Id) opps, SUM(Finance_ARR_USD__c) arrUsd FROM Opportunity WHERE IsClosed = false AND (Owner.UserRole.Name = null OR Owner.UserRole.Name NOT IN ('AE-EMEA-FR','AE-EMEA-DACH','AE-EMEA-SOUTH','AE-EMEA-CEE','AE-EMEA-BENELUX','AE-EMEA-MEA','AE-EMEA-IBERIA-LATAM','AE-EMEA-NORDICS','SMB-EMEA','EM-EMEA','EM-EMEA-LATAM','BDR-EMEA','DIR-SALES-EMEA','MGR-SALES-EMEA','VP-SALES-EMEA','DIR-EM-EMEA','DIR-BDR-EMEA')) AND Account.Sales_Region__c IN ('Northern Europe','FME','DACH','Iberia','Southern Europe','MEA','LATAM') GROUP BY Owner.UserRole.Name, Account.Sales_Region__c, RecordType.Name, FISCAL_YEAR(CloseDate), FISCAL_QUARTER(CloseDate) LIMIT 2000

pipe_rep.title: Open pipeline by rep
pipe_rep.description: Open EMEA New Business and Upsell pipeline per rep for this and next quarter, in incremental ARR (USD).

args.q: SELECT Owner.Name owner, Owner.UserRole.Name role, Owner.Manager.Name manager, FISCAL_YEAR(CloseDate) fy, FISCAL_QUARTER(CloseDate) fq, COUNT(Id) opps, SUM(Finance_ARR_USD__c) arrUsd FROM Opportunity WHERE IsClosed = false AND (CloseDate = THIS_FISCAL_QUARTER OR CloseDate = NEXT_FISCAL_QUARTER) AND RecordType.Name != 'Renewal' AND Owner.UserRole.Name IN ('AE-EMEA-FR','AE-EMEA-DACH','AE-EMEA-SOUTH','AE-EMEA-CEE','AE-EMEA-BENELUX','AE-EMEA-MEA','AE-EMEA-IBERIA-LATAM','AE-EMEA-NORDICS','SMB-EMEA','EM-EMEA','EM-EMEA-LATAM','BDR-EMEA','DIR-SALES-EMEA','MGR-SALES-EMEA','VP-SALES-EMEA','DIR-EM-EMEA','DIR-BDR-EMEA') GROUP BY Owner.Name, Owner.UserRole.Name, Owner.Manager.Name, FISCAL_YEAR(CloseDate), FISCAL_QUARTER(CloseDate) LIMIT 2000

pipe_pastdue.title: Past-due opps by rep
pipe_pastdue.description: Open EMEA New Business and Upsell opportunities whose close date has passed, per rep.

args.q: SELECT Owner.Name owner, Owner.UserRole.Name role, Owner.Manager.Name manager, COUNT(Id) pastDueOpps, SUM(Finance_ARR_USD__c) pastDueArrUsd FROM Opportunity WHERE IsClosed = false AND CloseDate < TODAY AND RecordType.Name != 'Renewal' AND Owner.UserRole.Name IN ('AE-EMEA-FR','AE-EMEA-DACH','AE-EMEA-SOUTH','AE-EMEA-CEE','AE-EMEA-BENELUX','AE-EMEA-MEA','AE-EMEA-IBERIA-LATAM','AE-EMEA-NORDICS','SMB-EMEA','EM-EMEA','EM-EMEA-LATAM','BDR-EMEA','DIR-SALES-EMEA','MGR-SALES-EMEA','VP-SALES-EMEA','DIR-EM-EMEA','DIR-BDR-EMEA') GROUP BY Owner.Name, Owner.UserRole.Name, Owner.Manager.Name LIMIT 2000

pipe_stale.title: Stale opps by rep
pipe_stale.description: Open EMEA New Business and Upsell opportunities closing this or next quarter with no logged activity in 30 days, per rep.

args.q: SELECT Owner.Name owner, COUNT(Id) staleOpps, SUM(Finance_ARR_USD__c) staleArrUsd FROM Opportunity WHERE IsClosed = false AND (CloseDate = THIS_FISCAL_QUARTER OR CloseDate = NEXT_FISCAL_QUARTER) AND RecordType.Name != 'Renewal' AND (LastActivityDate = null OR LastActivityDate < LAST_N_DAYS:30) AND Owner.UserRole.Name IN ('AE-EMEA-FR','AE-EMEA-DACH','AE-EMEA-SOUTH','AE-EMEA-CEE','AE-EMEA-BENELUX','AE-EMEA-MEA','AE-EMEA-IBERIA-LATAM','AE-EMEA-NORDICS','SMB-EMEA','EM-EMEA','EM-EMEA-LATAM','BDR-EMEA','DIR-SALES-EMEA','MGR-SALES-EMEA','VP-SALES-EMEA','DIR-EM-EMEA','DIR-BDR-EMEA') GROUP BY Owner.Name LIMIT 2000

won_q.title: Closed won this quarter
won_q.description: EMEA closed-won opportunities this quarter (by the date they were actually closed, as in Bookings) by type, with the owner's role and manager now and when the deal closed (a deal counts for the team that closed it), in incremental ARR (USD).

args.q: SELECT Owner.UserRole.Name role, Owner.Manager.Name manager, Closed_Owner_Role__c closedRole, Closed_Owner_Manager__c closedManager, RecordType.Name recordType, COUNT(Id) wonOpps, SUM(Finance_ARR_USD__c) wonArrUsd FROM Opportunity WHERE IsWon = true AND Actual_Close_Date__c = THIS_FISCAL_QUARTER AND (Closed_Owner_Role__c IN ('AE-EMEA-FR','AE-EMEA-DACH','AE-EMEA-SOUTH','AE-EMEA-CEE','AE-EMEA-BENELUX','AE-EMEA-MEA','AE-EMEA-IBERIA-LATAM','AE-EMEA-NORDICS','SMB-EMEA','EM-EMEA','EM-EMEA-LATAM','BDR-EMEA','DIR-SALES-EMEA','MGR-SALES-EMEA','VP-SALES-EMEA','DIR-EM-EMEA','DIR-BDR-EMEA') OR Owner.UserRole.Name IN ('AE-EMEA-FR','AE-EMEA-DACH','AE-EMEA-SOUTH','AE-EMEA-CEE','AE-EMEA-BENELUX','AE-EMEA-MEA','AE-EMEA-IBERIA-LATAM','AE-EMEA-NORDICS','SMB-EMEA','EM-EMEA','EM-EMEA-LATAM','BDR-EMEA','DIR-SALES-EMEA','MGR-SALES-EMEA','VP-SALES-EMEA','DIR-EM-EMEA','DIR-BDR-EMEA')) GROUP BY Owner.UserRole.Name, Owner.Manager.Name, Closed_Owner_Role__c, Closed_Owner_Manager__c, RecordType.Name LIMIT 2000

renew_stake.title: Renewals at stake
renew_stake.description: Open EMEA renewals closing this or next quarter by owner role, manager and stage, with the renewing contract ARR (USD).

args.q: SELECT Owner.UserRole.Name role, Owner.Manager.Name manager, StageName stage, FISCAL_YEAR(CloseDate) fy, FISCAL_QUARTER(CloseDate) fq, COUNT(Id) renewals, SUM(Order_Form_ARR_USD__c) renewingArrUsd, SUM(Finance_ARR_USD__c) netChangeArrUsd FROM Opportunity WHERE IsClosed = false AND (CloseDate = THIS_FISCAL_QUARTER OR CloseDate = NEXT_FISCAL_QUARTER) AND RecordType.Name = 'Renewal' AND Owner.UserRole.Name IN ('AE-EMEA-FR','AE-EMEA-DACH','AE-EMEA-SOUTH','AE-EMEA-CEE','AE-EMEA-BENELUX','AE-EMEA-MEA','AE-EMEA-IBERIA-LATAM','AE-EMEA-NORDICS','SMB-EMEA','EM-EMEA','EM-EMEA-LATAM','BDR-EMEA','DIR-SALES-EMEA','MGR-SALES-EMEA','VP-SALES-EMEA','DIR-EM-EMEA','DIR-BDR-EMEA') GROUP BY Owner.UserRole.Name, Owner.Manager.Name, StageName, FISCAL_YEAR(CloseDate), FISCAL_QUARTER(CloseDate) LIMIT 2000

cr_daily.title: Created opps per day
cr_daily.description: EMEA-owned opportunities created per day this quarter and last, by type, excluding renewals auto-created by Flow.

args.q: SELECT DAY_ONLY(convertTimezone(CreatedDate)) day, RecordType.Name rt, COUNT(Id) opps, SUM(Finance_ARR_USD__c) arrUsd FROM Opportunity WHERE (CreatedDate = THIS_FISCAL_QUARTER OR CreatedDate = LAST_FISCAL_QUARTER) AND Owner.UserRole.Name IN ('AE-EMEA-FR','AE-EMEA-DACH','AE-EMEA-SOUTH','AE-EMEA-CEE','AE-EMEA-BENELUX','AE-EMEA-MEA','AE-EMEA-IBERIA-LATAM','AE-EMEA-NORDICS','SMB-EMEA','EM-EMEA','EM-EMEA-LATAM','BDR-EMEA','DIR-SALES-EMEA','MGR-SALES-EMEA','VP-SALES-EMEA','DIR-EM-EMEA','DIR-BDR-EMEA') AND (RecordType.Name != 'Renewal' OR Upsell_Renewal_Created_By__c != 'Flow') GROUP BY DAY_ONLY(convertTimezone(CreatedDate)), RecordType.Name ORDER BY DAY_ONLY(convertTimezone(CreatedDate)) LIMIT 2000

cr_monthly.title: Created opps per month
cr_monthly.description: EMEA-owned opportunities created per month over the last 12 months, by type, excluding renewals auto-created by Flow.

args.q: SELECT CALENDAR_YEAR(convertTimezone(CreatedDate)) yr, CALENDAR_MONTH(convertTimezone(CreatedDate)) mo, RecordType.Name rt, COUNT(Id) opps, SUM(Finance_ARR_USD__c) arrUsd FROM Opportunity WHERE (CreatedDate = LAST_N_MONTHS:12 OR CreatedDate = THIS_MONTH) AND Owner.UserRole.Name IN ('AE-EMEA-FR','AE-EMEA-DACH','AE-EMEA-SOUTH','AE-EMEA-CEE','AE-EMEA-BENELUX','AE-EMEA-MEA','AE-EMEA-IBERIA-LATAM','AE-EMEA-NORDICS','SMB-EMEA','EM-EMEA','EM-EMEA-LATAM','BDR-EMEA','DIR-SALES-EMEA','MGR-SALES-EMEA','VP-SALES-EMEA','DIR-EM-EMEA','DIR-BDR-EMEA') AND (RecordType.Name != 'Renewal' OR Upsell_Renewal_Created_By__c != 'Flow') GROUP BY CALENDAR_YEAR(convertTimezone(CreatedDate)), CALENDAR_MONTH(convertTimezone(CreatedDate)), RecordType.Name LIMIT 2000

cr_source.title: Created opps by source
cr_source.description: EMEA-owned opportunities created this and last quarter by type, lead source, creator role and originating BDR role.

args.q: SELECT CALENDAR_YEAR(convertTimezone(CreatedDate)) yr, CALENDAR_QUARTER(convertTimezone(CreatedDate)) qtr, RecordType.Name rt, LeadSource leadSource, CreatedBy.UserRole.Name creatorRole, Originating_BDR_Role__c bdrRole, COUNT(Id) opps, SUM(Finance_ARR_USD__c) arrUsd FROM Opportunity WHERE (CreatedDate = THIS_FISCAL_QUARTER OR CreatedDate = LAST_FISCAL_QUARTER) AND Owner.UserRole.Name IN ('AE-EMEA-FR','AE-EMEA-DACH','AE-EMEA-SOUTH','AE-EMEA-CEE','AE-EMEA-BENELUX','AE-EMEA-MEA','AE-EMEA-IBERIA-LATAM','AE-EMEA-NORDICS','SMB-EMEA','EM-EMEA','EM-EMEA-LATAM','BDR-EMEA','DIR-SALES-EMEA','MGR-SALES-EMEA','VP-SALES-EMEA','DIR-EM-EMEA','DIR-BDR-EMEA') AND (RecordType.Name != 'Renewal' OR Upsell_Renewal_Created_By__c != 'Flow') GROUP BY CALENDAR_YEAR(convertTimezone(CreatedDate)), CALENDAR_QUARTER(convertTimezone(CreatedDate)), RecordType.Name, LeadSource, CreatedBy.UserRole.Name, Originating_BDR_Role__c LIMIT 2000

cr_owner_q.title: Created opps by rep
cr_owner_q.description: EMEA opportunities created this quarter per owner and type, with how many a BDR sourced.

args.q: SELECT Owner.Name owner, Owner.UserRole.Name role, Owner.Manager.Name manager, RecordType.Name rt, COUNT(Id) opps, SUM(Finance_ARR_USD__c) arrUsd, COUNT(Originating_BDR__c) bdrSourced FROM Opportunity WHERE CreatedDate = THIS_FISCAL_QUARTER AND Owner.UserRole.Name IN ('AE-EMEA-FR','AE-EMEA-DACH','AE-EMEA-SOUTH','AE-EMEA-CEE','AE-EMEA-BENELUX','AE-EMEA-MEA','AE-EMEA-IBERIA-LATAM','AE-EMEA-NORDICS','SMB-EMEA','EM-EMEA','EM-EMEA-LATAM','BDR-EMEA','DIR-SALES-EMEA','MGR-SALES-EMEA','VP-SALES-EMEA','DIR-EM-EMEA','DIR-BDR-EMEA') AND (RecordType.Name != 'Renewal' OR Upsell_Renewal_Created_By__c != 'Flow') GROUP BY Owner.Name, Owner.UserRole.Name, Owner.Manager.Name, RecordType.Name LIMIT 2000

cr_bdr.title: BDR-sourced opps
cr_bdr.description: Opportunities sourced by EMEA BDRs (BDR-EMEA and DIR-BDR-EMEA roles) this and last quarter, per BDR, whoever owns them; by the role stamped on the deal, or the BDR's current role when none was stamped; renewals auto-created by Flow left out.

args.q: SELECT CALENDAR_YEAR(convertTimezone(CreatedDate)) yr, CALENDAR_QUARTER(convertTimezone(CreatedDate)) qtr, Originating_BDR__r.Name bdr, Originating_BDR__r.Manager.Name bdrManager, COUNT(Id) opps, SUM(Finance_ARR_USD__c) arrUsd FROM Opportunity WHERE (CreatedDate = THIS_FISCAL_QUARTER OR CreatedDate = LAST_FISCAL_QUARTER) AND (Originating_BDR_Role__c IN ('BDR-EMEA', 'DIR-BDR-EMEA') OR (Originating_BDR_Role__c = null AND Originating_BDR__r.UserRole.Name IN ('BDR-EMEA', 'DIR-BDR-EMEA'))) AND (RecordType.Name != 'Renewal' OR Upsell_Renewal_Created_By__c != 'Flow') GROUP BY CALENDAR_YEAR(convertTimezone(CreatedDate)), CALENDAR_QUARTER(convertTimezone(CreatedDate)), Originating_BDR__r.Name, Originating_BDR__r.Manager.Name LIMIT 2000

rr_members.title: Routing pool members
rr_members.description: Members of every EMEA LeanData round-robin pool, with the member's role, active flag, status and when they were added.

args.q: SELECT LeanData__Pool__r.LeanData__Grouping_Name__c poolName, LeanData__OwnerId__c userId, LeanData__User_Owner__r.Name userName, LeanData__User_Owner__r.UserRole.Name userRole, LeanData__User_Owner__r.IsActive userActive, LeanData__Status__c memberStatus, MIN(CreatedDate) addedOn FROM LeanData__Round_Robin_Setting__c WHERE (LeanData__Pool__r.LeanData__Grouping_Name__c LIKE '%EMEA%' OR LeanData__Pool__r.LeanData__Grouping_Name__c LIKE '%MEA%' OR LeanData__Pool__r.LeanData__Grouping_Name__c LIKE '%Baltics%' OR LeanData__Pool__r.LeanData__Grouping_Name__c LIKE '%Benelux%' OR LeanData__Pool__r.LeanData__Grouping_Name__c LIKE '%CEE%' OR LeanData__Pool__r.LeanData__Grouping_Name__c LIKE '%DACH%' OR LeanData__Pool__r.LeanData__Grouping_Name__c LIKE '%Germany%' OR LeanData__Pool__r.LeanData__Grouping_Name__c LIKE '%France%' OR LeanData__Pool__r.LeanData__Grouping_Name__c LIKE '%Italy%' OR LeanData__Pool__r.LeanData__Grouping_Name__c LIKE '%Iberia%' OR LeanData__Pool__r.LeanData__Grouping_Name__c LIKE '%LATAM%' OR LeanData__Pool__r.LeanData__Grouping_Name__c LIKE '%Nordics%' OR LeanData__Pool__r.LeanData__Grouping_Name__c LIKE '%Southern Europe%' OR LeanData__Pool__r.LeanData__Grouping_Name__c LIKE 'RR Gov:%') GROUP BY LeanData__Pool__r.LeanData__Grouping_Name__c, LeanData__OwnerId__c, LeanData__User_Owner__r.Name, LeanData__User_Owner__r.UserRole.Name, LeanData__User_Owner__r.IsActive, LeanData__Status__c LIMIT 2000

rr_assign.title: Routing assignments, 90 days
rr_assign.description: Leads and records LeanData assigned through each EMEA pool per member in the last 90 days (counts only).

args.q: SELECT LeanData__Round_Robin_Pool__r.LeanData__Grouping_Name__c poolName, LeanData__Round_Robin_Chosen_OwnerId__c userId, COUNT(Id) assignments, MAX(CreatedDate) lastAssigned FROM LeanData__Log__c WHERE LeanData__Round_Robin_Pool__c != null AND CreatedDate = LAST_N_DAYS:90 AND (LeanData__Round_Robin_Pool__r.LeanData__Grouping_Name__c LIKE '%EMEA%' OR LeanData__Round_Robin_Pool__r.LeanData__Grouping_Name__c LIKE '%MEA%' OR LeanData__Round_Robin_Pool__r.LeanData__Grouping_Name__c LIKE '%Baltics%' OR LeanData__Round_Robin_Pool__r.LeanData__Grouping_Name__c LIKE '%Benelux%' OR LeanData__Round_Robin_Pool__r.LeanData__Grouping_Name__c LIKE '%CEE%' OR LeanData__Round_Robin_Pool__r.LeanData__Grouping_Name__c LIKE '%DACH%' OR LeanData__Round_Robin_Pool__r.LeanData__Grouping_Name__c LIKE '%Germany%' OR LeanData__Round_Robin_Pool__r.LeanData__Grouping_Name__c LIKE '%France%' OR LeanData__Round_Robin_Pool__r.LeanData__Grouping_Name__c LIKE '%Italy%' OR LeanData__Round_Robin_Pool__r.LeanData__Grouping_Name__c LIKE '%Iberia%' OR LeanData__Round_Robin_Pool__r.LeanData__Grouping_Name__c LIKE '%LATAM%' OR LeanData__Round_Robin_Pool__r.LeanData__Grouping_Name__c LIKE '%Nordics%' OR LeanData__Round_Robin_Pool__r.LeanData__Grouping_Name__c LIKE '%Southern Europe%' OR LeanData__Round_Robin_Pool__r.LeanData__Grouping_Name__c LIKE 'RR Gov:%') GROUP BY LeanData__Round_Robin_Pool__r.LeanData__Grouping_Name__c, LeanData__Round_Robin_Chosen_OwnerId__c LIMIT 2000

roster.title: EMEA sales roster
roster.description: Every Salesforce user in an EMEA sales role (UK&I excluded), active or not, with manager and created date.

args.q: SELECT Id userId, Name name, UserRole.Name role, Title title, Manager.Name manager, IsActive isActive, Legora_Start_Date__c startDate, DAY_ONLY(CreatedDate) createdDate FROM User WHERE UserRole.Name IN ('AE-EMEA-FR','AE-EMEA-DACH','AE-EMEA-SOUTH','AE-EMEA-CEE','AE-EMEA-BENELUX','AE-EMEA-MEA','AE-EMEA-IBERIA-LATAM','AE-EMEA-NORDICS','SMB-EMEA','EM-EMEA','EM-EMEA-LATAM','BDR-EMEA','DIR-SALES-EMEA','MGR-SALES-EMEA','VP-SALES-EMEA','DIR-EM-EMEA','DIR-BDR-EMEA') GROUP BY Id, Name, UserRole.Name, Title, Manager.Name, IsActive, Legora_Start_Date__c, DAY_ONLY(CreatedDate) LIMIT 2000

users_all.title: Salesforce users
users_all.description: Every active standard Salesforce user, any role, with email and manager. Used to match HiBob people to Salesforce by email.

args.q: SELECT Id userId, Name name, Email email, UserRole.Name role, Manager.Name manager FROM User WHERE IsActive = true AND UserType = 'Standard' GROUP BY Id, Name, Email, UserRole.Name, Manager.Name LIMIT 2000

hb_people.title: EMEA GTM people (HiBob)
hb_people.description: Everyone on headcount in HiBob's GTM EMEA, Engagement EMEA and Growth EMEA departments, with work email, title, team, site, manager and start date.

bk_owner.title: Account book per owner
bk_owner.description: Accounts and customer ARR (USD) owned by each EMEA rep, by account status.

args.q: SELECT Owner.Name owner, Owner.UserRole.Name role, Owner.Manager.Name manager, Owner.IsActive active, Account_Status__c status, COUNT(Id) accounts, SUM(ARR_USD__c) arrUsd FROM Account WHERE Owner.UserRole.Name IN ('AE-EMEA-FR','AE-EMEA-DACH','AE-EMEA-SOUTH','AE-EMEA-CEE','AE-EMEA-BENELUX','AE-EMEA-MEA','AE-EMEA-IBERIA-LATAM','AE-EMEA-NORDICS','SMB-EMEA','EM-EMEA','EM-EMEA-LATAM','BDR-EMEA','DIR-SALES-EMEA','MGR-SALES-EMEA','VP-SALES-EMEA','DIR-EM-EMEA','DIR-BDR-EMEA') GROUP BY Owner.Name, Owner.UserRole.Name, Owner.Manager.Name, Owner.IsActive, Account_Status__c LIMIT 2000

bk_pipe.title: Open pipeline per owner
bk_pipe.description: All open opportunities per EMEA owner and type, any close date, in incremental ARR (USD).

args.q: SELECT Owner.Name owner, RecordType.Name motion, COUNT(Id) openOpps, SUM(Finance_ARR_USD__c) openArrUsd FROM Opportunity WHERE IsClosed = false AND Owner.UserRole.Name IN ('AE-EMEA-FR','AE-EMEA-DACH','AE-EMEA-SOUTH','AE-EMEA-CEE','AE-EMEA-BENELUX','AE-EMEA-MEA','AE-EMEA-IBERIA-LATAM','AE-EMEA-NORDICS','SMB-EMEA','EM-EMEA','EM-EMEA-LATAM','BDR-EMEA','DIR-SALES-EMEA','MGR-SALES-EMEA','VP-SALES-EMEA','DIR-EM-EMEA','DIR-BDR-EMEA') GROUP BY Owner.Name, RecordType.Name LIMIT 2000

bk_em.title: Engagement manager books
bk_em.description: Customer accounts and ARR (USD) per EMEA engagement manager (the account's Engagement Manager field).

args.q: SELECT CSM__r.Name em, CSM__r.UserRole.Name emRole, CSM__r.Manager.Name emManager, CSM__r.IsActive emActive, COUNT(Id) accounts, SUM(ARR_USD__c) arrUsd FROM Account WHERE CSM__r.UserRole.Name IN ('AE-EMEA-FR','AE-EMEA-DACH','AE-EMEA-SOUTH','AE-EMEA-CEE','AE-EMEA-BENELUX','AE-EMEA-MEA','AE-EMEA-IBERIA-LATAM','AE-EMEA-NORDICS','SMB-EMEA','EM-EMEA','EM-EMEA-LATAM','BDR-EMEA','DIR-SALES-EMEA','MGR-SALES-EMEA','VP-SALES-EMEA','DIR-EM-EMEA','DIR-BDR-EMEA') AND Account_Status__c = 'Customer' GROUP BY CSM__r.Name, CSM__r.UserRole.Name, CSM__r.Manager.Name, CSM__r.IsActive LIMIT 2000

bk_terr.title: Territory coverage
bk_terr.description: Accounts and ARR (USD) in each EMEA sales region (incl. LATAM) by owner role and account status.

args.q: SELECT Sales_Region__c salesRegion, Owner.UserRole.Name ownerRole, Account_Status__c status, COUNT(Id) accounts, SUM(ARR_USD__c) arrUsd FROM Account WHERE Sales_Region__c IN ('Northern Europe','FME','DACH','Iberia','Southern Europe','MEA','LATAM') GROUP BY Sales_Region__c, Owner.UserRole.Name, Account_Status__c LIMIT 2000

bk_orphans.title: Orphan accounts
bk_orphans.description: Active accounts (customer, pipeline, engaging, or with ARR) in EMEA regions whose owner is inactive, has no role, is RevOps or sits outside EMEA.

args.q: SELECT Id accountId, Name account, Owner.Name owner, Owner.IsActive ownerActive, Owner.UserRole.Name ownerRole, BillingCountryCode country, Sales_Region__c salesRegion, Account_Status__c status, SUM(ARR_USD__c) arrUsd FROM Account WHERE Sales_Region__c IN ('Northern Europe','FME','DACH','Iberia','Southern Europe','MEA','LATAM') AND (Account_Status__c IN ('Customer','Pipeline','Engaging') OR ARR_USD__c > 0) AND (Owner.IsActive = false OR Owner.UserRoleId = null OR Owner.UserRole.Name = 'REVOPS' OR (NOT Owner.UserRole.Name LIKE '%EMEA%')) GROUP BY Id, Name, Owner.Name, Owner.IsActive, Owner.UserRole.Name, BillingCountryCode, Sales_Region__c, Account_Status__c ORDER BY SUM(ARR_USD__c) DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1500

bk_books.title: Account books by owner
bk_books.description: Accounts per account book (Territory ID) and owner, for accounts in an EMEA sales region (LATAM included).

args.q: SELECT Territory_ID__c book, Owner.Name owner, Owner.UserRole.Name ownerRole, Owner.IsActive ownerActive, COUNT(Id) accounts, SUM(ARR_USD__c) arrUsd FROM Account WHERE Territory_ID__c != null AND Sales_Region__c IN ('Northern Europe','FME','DACH','Iberia','Southern Europe','MEA','LATAM') GROUP BY Territory_ID__c, Owner.Name, Owner.UserRole.Name, Owner.IsActive LIMIT 2000

closed_rep.title: Closed won and lost
closed_rep.description: EMEA New Business and Upsell opportunities closed won or lost this quarter and last (by the date they were actually closed), per owner, type and lost reason, with the owner, role and manager now and when the deal closed (a deal counts for the team that closed it).

args.q: SELECT Owner.Name owner, Owner.UserRole.Name role, Owner.Manager.Name manager, Closed_Owner__c closedOwner, Closed_Owner_Role__c closedRole, Closed_Owner_Manager__c closedManager, RecordType.Name rt, IsWon won, Closed_Reason__c lostReason, FISCAL_YEAR(Actual_Close_Date__c) fy, FISCAL_QUARTER(Actual_Close_Date__c) fq, COUNT(Id) opps, SUM(Finance_ARR_USD__c) arrUsd FROM Opportunity WHERE IsClosed = true AND (Actual_Close_Date__c = THIS_FISCAL_QUARTER OR Actual_Close_Date__c = LAST_FISCAL_QUARTER) AND RecordType.Name != 'Renewal' AND (Closed_Owner_Role__c IN ('AE-EMEA-FR','AE-EMEA-DACH','AE-EMEA-SOUTH','AE-EMEA-CEE','AE-EMEA-BENELUX','AE-EMEA-MEA','AE-EMEA-IBERIA-LATAM','AE-EMEA-NORDICS','SMB-EMEA','EM-EMEA','EM-EMEA-LATAM','BDR-EMEA','DIR-SALES-EMEA','MGR-SALES-EMEA','VP-SALES-EMEA','DIR-EM-EMEA','DIR-BDR-EMEA') OR Owner.UserRole.Name IN ('AE-EMEA-FR','AE-EMEA-DACH','AE-EMEA-SOUTH','AE-EMEA-CEE','AE-EMEA-BENELUX','AE-EMEA-MEA','AE-EMEA-IBERIA-LATAM','AE-EMEA-NORDICS','SMB-EMEA','EM-EMEA','EM-EMEA-LATAM','BDR-EMEA','DIR-SALES-EMEA','MGR-SALES-EMEA','VP-SALES-EMEA','DIR-EM-EMEA','DIR-BDR-EMEA')) GROUP BY Owner.Name, Owner.UserRole.Name, Owner.Manager.Name, Closed_Owner__c, Closed_Owner_Role__c, Closed_Owner_Manager__c, RecordType.Name, IsWon, Closed_Reason__c, FISCAL_YEAR(Actual_Close_Date__c), FISCAL_QUARTER(Actual_Close_Date__c) LIMIT 2000

cr_owner_m.title: Created opps per rep per month
cr_owner_m.description: EMEA-owned opportunities created per owner per month over the last 6 months and this one, with the first one each month (Flow renewals excluded).

args.q: SELECT Owner.Name owner, Owner.UserRole.Name role, CALENDAR_YEAR(convertTimezone(CreatedDate)) yr, CALENDAR_MONTH(convertTimezone(CreatedDate)) mo, RecordType.Name rt, COUNT(Id) opps, SUM(Finance_ARR_USD__c) arrUsd, MIN(CreatedDate) firstCreated FROM Opportunity WHERE (CreatedDate = LAST_N_MONTHS:6 OR CreatedDate = THIS_MONTH) AND Owner.UserRole.Name IN ('AE-EMEA-FR','AE-EMEA-DACH','AE-EMEA-SOUTH','AE-EMEA-CEE','AE-EMEA-BENELUX','AE-EMEA-MEA','AE-EMEA-IBERIA-LATAM','AE-EMEA-NORDICS','SMB-EMEA','EM-EMEA','EM-EMEA-LATAM','BDR-EMEA','DIR-SALES-EMEA','MGR-SALES-EMEA','VP-SALES-EMEA','DIR-EM-EMEA','DIR-BDR-EMEA') AND (RecordType.Name != 'Renewal' OR Upsell_Renewal_Created_By__c != 'Flow') GROUP BY Owner.Name, Owner.UserRole.Name, CALENDAR_YEAR(convertTimezone(CreatedDate)), CALENDAR_MONTH(convertTimezone(CreatedDate)), RecordType.Name LIMIT 2000

pipe_nextstep.title: Next-step dates
pipe_nextstep.description: Open EMEA New Business and Upsell opportunities closing this or next quarter with no next step at all (neither a note nor a date) or an overdue next-step date, per owner and quarter.

args.q: SELECT Owner.Name owner, Owner.UserRole.Name role, Owner.Manager.Name manager, FISCAL_YEAR(CloseDate) fy, FISCAL_QUARTER(CloseDate) fq, COUNT(Id) flaggedOpps, COUNT(Next_Steps_Date__c) overdueOpps, SUM(Finance_ARR_USD__c) flaggedArrUsd, MIN(Next_Steps_Date__c) oldestOverdue FROM Opportunity WHERE IsClosed = false AND (CloseDate = THIS_FISCAL_QUARTER OR CloseDate = NEXT_FISCAL_QUARTER) AND RecordType.Name != 'Renewal' AND (Next_Steps_Date__c < TODAY OR (Next_Steps_Date__c = null AND NextStep = null)) AND Owner.UserRole.Name IN ('AE-EMEA-FR','AE-EMEA-DACH','AE-EMEA-SOUTH','AE-EMEA-CEE','AE-EMEA-BENELUX','AE-EMEA-MEA','AE-EMEA-IBERIA-LATAM','AE-EMEA-NORDICS','SMB-EMEA','EM-EMEA','EM-EMEA-LATAM','BDR-EMEA','DIR-SALES-EMEA','MGR-SALES-EMEA','VP-SALES-EMEA','DIR-EM-EMEA','DIR-BDR-EMEA') GROUP BY Owner.Name, Owner.UserRole.Name, Owner.Manager.Name, FISCAL_YEAR(CloseDate), FISCAL_QUARTER(CloseDate) LIMIT 2000

pipe_slips.title: Close-date moves, 30 days
pipe_slips.description: Open EMEA New Business and Upsell opportunities whose latest close-date change was in the last 30 days, per owner, by the quarter the date moved from and to.

args.q: SELECT Owner.Name owner, Owner.UserRole.Name role, Owner.Manager.Name manager, FISCAL_YEAR(LastCloseDateChangedHistory.PrevCloseDate) fromFy, FISCAL_QUARTER(LastCloseDateChangedHistory.PrevCloseDate) fromFq, FISCAL_YEAR(CloseDate) toFy, FISCAL_QUARTER(CloseDate) toFq, COUNT(Id) opps, SUM(Finance_ARR_USD__c) arrUsd, SUM(Close_Quarter_Push_Count__c) quarterPushes FROM Opportunity WHERE IsClosed = false AND RecordType.Name != 'Renewal' AND Owner.UserRole.Name IN ('AE-EMEA-FR','AE-EMEA-DACH','AE-EMEA-SOUTH','AE-EMEA-CEE','AE-EMEA-BENELUX','AE-EMEA-MEA','AE-EMEA-IBERIA-LATAM','AE-EMEA-NORDICS','SMB-EMEA','EM-EMEA','EM-EMEA-LATAM','BDR-EMEA','DIR-SALES-EMEA','MGR-SALES-EMEA','VP-SALES-EMEA','DIR-EM-EMEA','DIR-BDR-EMEA') AND LastCloseDateChangedHistory.CreatedDate = LAST_N_DAYS:30 AND LastCloseDateChangedHistory.PrevCloseDate != null GROUP BY Owner.Name, Owner.UserRole.Name, Owner.Manager.Name, FISCAL_YEAR(LastCloseDateChangedHistory.PrevCloseDate), FISCAL_QUARTER(LastCloseDateChangedHistory.PrevCloseDate), FISCAL_YEAR(CloseDate), FISCAL_QUARTER(CloseDate) LIMIT 2000

pipe_edits.title: Close-date edits, 30 days
pipe_edits.description: Close-date edits on open EMEA New Business and Upsell opportunities in the last 30 days, per owner, including repeat edits of the same deal.

args.q: SELECT Opportunity.Owner.Name owner, COUNT(Id) closeDateEdits, COUNT_DISTINCT(OpportunityId) oppsEdited, MAX(CreatedDate) lastEdit FROM OpportunityFieldHistory WHERE Field = 'CloseDate' AND CreatedDate = LAST_N_DAYS:30 AND Opportunity.IsClosed = false AND Opportunity.RecordType.Name != 'Renewal' AND Opportunity.Owner.UserRole.Name IN ('AE-EMEA-FR','AE-EMEA-DACH','AE-EMEA-SOUTH','AE-EMEA-CEE','AE-EMEA-BENELUX','AE-EMEA-MEA','AE-EMEA-IBERIA-LATAM','AE-EMEA-NORDICS','SMB-EMEA','EM-EMEA','EM-EMEA-LATAM','BDR-EMEA','DIR-SALES-EMEA','MGR-SALES-EMEA','VP-SALES-EMEA','DIR-EM-EMEA','DIR-BDR-EMEA') GROUP BY Opportunity.Owner.Name LIMIT 2000

pipe_early.title: Early-stage deals this quarter
pipe_early.description: Open EMEA New Business and Upsell opportunities closing this quarter that are still at stage 0 or 1, per owner.

args.q: SELECT Owner.Name owner, Owner.UserRole.Name role, Owner.Manager.Name manager, COUNT(Id) opps, SUM(Finance_ARR_USD__c) arrUsd FROM Opportunity WHERE IsClosed = false AND CloseDate = THIS_FISCAL_QUARTER AND RecordType.Name != 'Renewal' AND (StageName LIKE '0%' OR StageName LIKE '1%') AND Owner.UserRole.Name IN ('AE-EMEA-FR','AE-EMEA-DACH','AE-EMEA-SOUTH','AE-EMEA-CEE','AE-EMEA-BENELUX','AE-EMEA-MEA','AE-EMEA-IBERIA-LATAM','AE-EMEA-NORDICS','SMB-EMEA','EM-EMEA','EM-EMEA-LATAM','BDR-EMEA','DIR-SALES-EMEA','MGR-SALES-EMEA','VP-SALES-EMEA','DIR-EM-EMEA','DIR-BDR-EMEA') GROUP BY Owner.Name, Owner.UserRole.Name, Owner.Manager.Name LIMIT 2000

pipe_nocontact.title: Deals with no contact role
pipe_nocontact.description: Open EMEA New Business and Upsell opportunities closing this quarter with no contact role, per owner.

args.q: SELECT Owner.Name owner, Owner.UserRole.Name role, Owner.Manager.Name manager, COUNT(Id) noContactOpps, SUM(Finance_ARR_USD__c) noContactArrUsd FROM Opportunity WHERE IsClosed = false AND CloseDate = THIS_FISCAL_QUARTER AND RecordType.Name != 'Renewal' AND Owner.UserRole.Name IN ('AE-EMEA-FR','AE-EMEA-DACH','AE-EMEA-SOUTH','AE-EMEA-CEE','AE-EMEA-BENELUX','AE-EMEA-MEA','AE-EMEA-IBERIA-LATAM','AE-EMEA-NORDICS','SMB-EMEA','EM-EMEA','EM-EMEA-LATAM','BDR-EMEA','DIR-SALES-EMEA','MGR-SALES-EMEA','VP-SALES-EMEA','DIR-EM-EMEA','DIR-BDR-EMEA') AND Id NOT IN (SELECT OpportunityId FROM OpportunityContactRole) GROUP BY Owner.Name, Owner.UserRole.Name, Owner.Manager.Name LIMIT 2000

top_deals.title: Largest open deals
top_deals.description: The 300 largest open EMEA New Business and Upsell opportunities closing this or next quarter, with owner, stage, close date, forecast category, next step and its date, last activity, days in the current stage and age.

args.q: SELECT Id oppId, Name opp, Account.Name account, Owner.Name owner, Owner.UserRole.Name role, Owner.Manager.Name manager, StageName stage, RecordType.Name rt, CloseDate closeDate, Rep_Forecast_Category__c forecast, NextStep nextStep, Next_Steps_Date__c nextStepDate, LastActivityDate lastActivity, DAY_ONLY(CreatedDate) createdDate, MAX(LastStageChangeInDays) daysInStage, MAX(AgeInDays) ageDays, SUM(Finance_ARR_USD__c) arrUsd FROM Opportunity WHERE IsClosed = false AND (CloseDate = THIS_FISCAL_QUARTER OR CloseDate = NEXT_FISCAL_QUARTER) AND RecordType.Name != 'Renewal' AND Owner.UserRole.Name IN ('AE-EMEA-FR','AE-EMEA-DACH','AE-EMEA-SOUTH','AE-EMEA-CEE','AE-EMEA-BENELUX','AE-EMEA-MEA','AE-EMEA-IBERIA-LATAM','AE-EMEA-NORDICS','SMB-EMEA','EM-EMEA','EM-EMEA-LATAM','BDR-EMEA','DIR-SALES-EMEA','MGR-SALES-EMEA','VP-SALES-EMEA','DIR-EM-EMEA','DIR-BDR-EMEA') GROUP BY Id, Name, Account.Name, Owner.Name, Owner.UserRole.Name, Owner.Manager.Name, StageName, RecordType.Name, CloseDate, Rep_Forecast_Category__c, NextStep, Next_Steps_Date__c, LastActivityDate, DAY_ONLY(CreatedDate) ORDER BY SUM(Finance_ARR_USD__c) DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 300

top_renewals.title: Largest open renewals
top_renewals.description: The 300 largest open EMEA renewals closing this or next quarter by renewing contract ARR, with prior ARR, net change, stage, forecast, next step and last activity.

args.q: SELECT Id oppId, Name opp, Owner.Name owner, Owner.UserRole.Name role, Owner.Manager.Name manager, StageName stage, CloseDate closeDate, Rep_Forecast_Category__c forecast, NextStep nextStep, LastActivityDate lastActivity, SUM(Order_Form_ARR_USD__c) renewingArrUsd, SUM(Existing_ARR_USD__c) existingArrUsd, SUM(Finance_ARR_USD__c) netChangeArrUsd FROM Opportunity WHERE IsClosed = false AND (CloseDate = THIS_FISCAL_QUARTER OR CloseDate = NEXT_FISCAL_QUARTER) AND RecordType.Name = 'Renewal' AND Owner.UserRole.Name IN ('AE-EMEA-FR','AE-EMEA-DACH','AE-EMEA-SOUTH','AE-EMEA-CEE','AE-EMEA-BENELUX','AE-EMEA-MEA','AE-EMEA-IBERIA-LATAM','AE-EMEA-NORDICS','SMB-EMEA','EM-EMEA','EM-EMEA-LATAM','BDR-EMEA','DIR-SALES-EMEA','MGR-SALES-EMEA','VP-SALES-EMEA','DIR-EM-EMEA','DIR-BDR-EMEA') GROUP BY Id, Name, Owner.Name, Owner.UserRole.Name, Owner.Manager.Name, StageName, CloseDate, Rep_Forecast_Category__c, NextStep, LastActivityDate ORDER BY SUM(Order_Form_ARR_USD__c) DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 300

deals.title: Open deals of one person
deals.description: Every open opportunity (any type and close date, up to 200) owned by the person open in the person panel.

args.q: SELECT Id oppId, Name opp, Account.Name account, StageName stage, RecordType.Name rt, CloseDate closeDate, Rep_Forecast_Category__c forecast, NextStep nextStep, Next_Steps_Date__c nextStepDate, LastActivityDate lastActivity, MAX(LastStageChangeInDays) daysInStage, SUM(Finance_ARR_USD__c) arrUsd, SUM(Order_Form_ARR_USD__c) contractArrUsd FROM Opportunity WHERE IsClosed = false AND OwnerId = {{dealOwnerId}} GROUP BY Id, Name, Account.Name, StageName, RecordType.Name, CloseDate, Rep_Forecast_Category__c, NextStep, Next_Steps_Date__c, LastActivityDate ORDER BY CloseDate ASC LIMIT 200

gr_notes.title: Granola meeting notes
gr_notes.description: Your Granola meetings in the chosen window (notes you took or were invited to), with up to three attendees' emails; the page then reads each note and keeps every line of its summary and private notes, with the headings above it.

mv_outcomes.title: Won and lost, last 7 days
mv_outcomes.description: EMEA New Business and Upsell deals closed won or lost in the last 7 days (by the date actually closed; admin merges and record clean-ups left out of lost), per owner, with the owner, role and manager now and when the deal closed (a deal counts for the team that closed it), in incremental ARR (USD).

args.q: SELECT Owner.Name owner, Owner.UserRole.Name role, Owner.Manager.Name manager, Closed_Owner__c closedOwner, Closed_Owner_Role__c closedRole, Closed_Owner_Manager__c closedManager, IsWon won, COUNT(Id) n, SUM(Finance_ARR_USD__c) arr FROM Opportunity WHERE RecordType.Name IN ('New Business','Upsell') AND (Closed_Owner_Role__c IN ('AE-EMEA-FR','AE-EMEA-DACH','AE-EMEA-SOUTH','AE-EMEA-CEE','AE-EMEA-BENELUX','AE-EMEA-MEA','AE-EMEA-IBERIA-LATAM','AE-EMEA-NORDICS','SMB-EMEA','EM-EMEA','EM-EMEA-LATAM','BDR-EMEA','DIR-SALES-EMEA','MGR-SALES-EMEA','VP-SALES-EMEA','DIR-EM-EMEA','DIR-BDR-EMEA') OR Owner.UserRole.Name IN ('AE-EMEA-FR','AE-EMEA-DACH','AE-EMEA-SOUTH','AE-EMEA-CEE','AE-EMEA-BENELUX','AE-EMEA-MEA','AE-EMEA-IBERIA-LATAM','AE-EMEA-NORDICS','SMB-EMEA','EM-EMEA','EM-EMEA-LATAM','BDR-EMEA','DIR-SALES-EMEA','MGR-SALES-EMEA','VP-SALES-EMEA','DIR-EM-EMEA','DIR-BDR-EMEA')) AND IsClosed = true AND Actual_Close_Date__c = LAST_N_DAYS:7 AND (IsWon = true OR Closed_Reason__c NOT IN ('Merged with Global Pilot','Record cleanup')) GROUP BY Owner.Name, Owner.UserRole.Name, Owner.Manager.Name, Closed_Owner__c, Closed_Owner_Role__c, Closed_Owner_Manager__c, IsWon LIMIT 2000

mv_created.title: Created, last 7 days
mv_created.description: EMEA New Business and Upsell opportunities created in the last 7 days, per owner and the fiscal quarter they close in, in incremental ARR (USD).

args.q: SELECT Owner.Name owner, Owner.UserRole.Name role, Owner.Manager.Name manager, FISCAL_YEAR(CloseDate) toFY, FISCAL_QUARTER(CloseDate) toFQ, COUNT(Id) opps, SUM(Finance_ARR_USD__c) arr FROM Opportunity WHERE CreatedDate = LAST_N_DAYS:7 AND RecordType.Name IN ('New Business','Upsell') AND Owner.UserRole.Name IN ('AE-EMEA-FR','AE-EMEA-DACH','AE-EMEA-SOUTH','AE-EMEA-CEE','AE-EMEA-BENELUX','AE-EMEA-MEA','AE-EMEA-IBERIA-LATAM','AE-EMEA-NORDICS','SMB-EMEA','EM-EMEA','EM-EMEA-LATAM','BDR-EMEA','DIR-SALES-EMEA','MGR-SALES-EMEA','VP-SALES-EMEA','DIR-EM-EMEA','DIR-BDR-EMEA') GROUP BY Owner.Name, Owner.UserRole.Name, Owner.Manager.Name, FISCAL_YEAR(CloseDate), FISCAL_QUARTER(CloseDate) LIMIT 2000

mv_close.title: Close dates moved across this quarter, last 7 days
mv_close.description: Close-date changes in the last 7 days on open EMEA New Business and Upsell deals created before the window that moved a deal out of this quarter or into it, one row per deal and from/to fiscal quarter with the first and last time it happened, the current owner and the deal's current incremental ARR (USD).

args.q: SELECT OpportunityId oppId, Opportunity.Owner.Name owner, Opportunity.Owner.UserRole.Name role, Opportunity.Owner.Manager.Name manager, FISCAL_YEAR(PrevCloseDate) fromFY, FISCAL_QUARTER(PrevCloseDate) fromFQ, FISCAL_YEAR(CloseDate) toFY, FISCAL_QUARTER(CloseDate) toFQ, MIN(CreatedDate) firstAt, MAX(CreatedDate) lastAt, MAX(Opportunity.Finance_ARR_USD__c) arr FROM OpportunityHistory WHERE CreatedDate = LAST_N_DAYS:7 AND Opportunity.RecordType.Name IN ('New Business','Upsell') AND Opportunity.Owner.UserRole.Name IN ('AE-EMEA-FR','AE-EMEA-DACH','AE-EMEA-SOUTH','AE-EMEA-CEE','AE-EMEA-BENELUX','AE-EMEA-MEA','AE-EMEA-IBERIA-LATAM','AE-EMEA-NORDICS','SMB-EMEA','EM-EMEA','EM-EMEA-LATAM','BDR-EMEA','DIR-SALES-EMEA','MGR-SALES-EMEA','VP-SALES-EMEA','DIR-EM-EMEA','DIR-BDR-EMEA') AND Opportunity.IsClosed = false AND Opportunity.CreatedDate < LAST_N_DAYS:7 AND ((PrevCloseDate = THIS_FISCAL_QUARTER AND (CloseDate > THIS_FISCAL_QUARTER OR CloseDate < THIS_FISCAL_QUARTER)) OR ((PrevCloseDate > THIS_FISCAL_QUARTER OR PrevCloseDate < THIS_FISCAL_QUARTER) AND CloseDate = THIS_FISCAL_QUARTER)) GROUP BY OpportunityId, Opportunity.Owner.Name, Opportunity.Owner.UserRole.Name, Opportunity.Owner.Manager.Name, FISCAL_YEAR(PrevCloseDate), FISCAL_QUARTER(PrevCloseDate), FISCAL_YEAR(CloseDate), FISCAL_QUARTER(CloseDate) LIMIT 2000

mv_fields.title: Stage and Commit changes, last 7 days
mv_fields.description: Stage and rep forecast category changes in the last 7 days on open EMEA New Business and Upsell deals created before the window, one row per change, with the deal's owner and current incremental ARR (USD).

args.q: SELECT OpportunityId, Opportunity.OwnerId, Opportunity.Finance_ARR_USD__c, Field, OldValue, NewValue, CreatedDate FROM OpportunityFieldHistory WHERE CreatedDate = LAST_N_DAYS:7 AND Field IN ('StageName','Rep_Forecast_Category__c') AND Opportunity.IsClosed = false AND Opportunity.CreatedDate < LAST_N_DAYS:7 AND Opportunity.RecordType.Name IN ('New Business','Upsell') AND Opportunity.Owner.UserRole.Name IN ('AE-EMEA-FR','AE-EMEA-DACH','AE-EMEA-SOUTH','AE-EMEA-CEE','AE-EMEA-BENELUX','AE-EMEA-MEA','AE-EMEA-IBERIA-LATAM','AE-EMEA-NORDICS','SMB-EMEA','EM-EMEA','EM-EMEA-LATAM','BDR-EMEA','DIR-SALES-EMEA','MGR-SALES-EMEA','VP-SALES-EMEA','DIR-EM-EMEA','DIR-BDR-EMEA') ORDER BY OpportunityId, CreatedDate, Id LIMIT 2000

age_stuck.title: Stuck deals by rep
age_stuck.description: Open EMEA New Business and Upsell deals closing this or next quarter that have sat in their stage longer than about twice the usual time (stage 0: 35 days, 1: 55, 2: 60, 3: 40, 4: 30, 5: 45, 6: 40), per owner and stage.

args.q: SELECT Owner.Name owner, Owner.UserRole.Name role, Owner.Manager.Name manager, StageName stage, COUNT(Id) stuckOpps, SUM(Finance_ARR_USD__c) stuckArrUsd, AVG(LastStageChangeInDays) avgDaysInStage, MAX(LastStageChangeInDays) maxDaysInStage FROM Opportunity WHERE IsClosed = false AND (CloseDate = THIS_FISCAL_QUARTER OR CloseDate = NEXT_FISCAL_QUARTER) AND RecordType.Name IN ('New Business','Upsell') AND ((StageName LIKE '0%' AND LastStageChangeInDays > 35) OR (StageName LIKE '1%' AND LastStageChangeInDays > 55) OR (StageName LIKE '2%' AND LastStageChangeInDays > 60) OR (StageName LIKE '3%' AND LastStageChangeInDays > 40) OR (StageName LIKE '4%' AND LastStageChangeInDays > 30) OR (StageName LIKE '5%' AND LastStageChangeInDays > 45) OR (StageName LIKE '6%' AND LastStageChangeInDays > 40)) AND Owner.UserRole.Name IN ('AE-EMEA-FR','AE-EMEA-DACH','AE-EMEA-SOUTH','AE-EMEA-CEE','AE-EMEA-BENELUX','AE-EMEA-MEA','AE-EMEA-IBERIA-LATAM','AE-EMEA-NORDICS','SMB-EMEA','EM-EMEA','EM-EMEA-LATAM','BDR-EMEA','DIR-SALES-EMEA','MGR-SALES-EMEA','VP-SALES-EMEA','DIR-EM-EMEA','DIR-BDR-EMEA') GROUP BY Owner.Name, Owner.UserRole.Name, Owner.Manager.Name, StageName LIMIT 2000

cycle_team.title: Sales cycle by team
cycle_team.description: EMEA New Business and Upsell deals won in the last 4 completed quarters per type, with the owner's role and manager now and when the deal closed (a deal counts for the team that closed it), and the average and longest days from creation to close.

args.q: SELECT Owner.UserRole.Name role, Owner.Manager.Name manager, Closed_Owner_Role__c closedRole, Closed_Owner_Manager__c closedManager, RecordType.Name rt, COUNT(Id) wonOpps, AVG(Days_from_Created_to_Close_Date__c) avgCycleDays, MAX(Days_from_Created_to_Close_Date__c) maxCycleDays, SUM(Finance_ARR_USD__c) wonArrUsd FROM Opportunity WHERE IsWon = true AND RecordType.Name IN ('New Business','Upsell') AND Actual_Close_Date__c = LAST_N_FISCAL_QUARTERS:4 AND (Closed_Owner_Role__c IN ('AE-EMEA-FR','AE-EMEA-DACH','AE-EMEA-SOUTH','AE-EMEA-CEE','AE-EMEA-BENELUX','AE-EMEA-MEA','AE-EMEA-IBERIA-LATAM','AE-EMEA-NORDICS','SMB-EMEA','EM-EMEA','EM-EMEA-LATAM','BDR-EMEA','DIR-SALES-EMEA','MGR-SALES-EMEA','VP-SALES-EMEA','DIR-EM-EMEA','DIR-BDR-EMEA') OR Owner.UserRole.Name IN ('AE-EMEA-FR','AE-EMEA-DACH','AE-EMEA-SOUTH','AE-EMEA-CEE','AE-EMEA-BENELUX','AE-EMEA-MEA','AE-EMEA-IBERIA-LATAM','AE-EMEA-NORDICS','SMB-EMEA','EM-EMEA','EM-EMEA-LATAM','BDR-EMEA','DIR-SALES-EMEA','MGR-SALES-EMEA','VP-SALES-EMEA','DIR-EM-EMEA','DIR-BDR-EMEA')) GROUP BY Owner.UserRole.Name, Owner.Manager.Name, Closed_Owner_Role__c, Closed_Owner_Manager__c, RecordType.Name LIMIT 2000

coverage_base.title: Bookings history and open pipeline
coverage_base.description: EMEA New Business and Upsell won and lost in the last 4 completed quarters and this one (admin merges left out of lost; a closed deal counts for the team that closed it), and open pipeline closing this and next quarter (deals past due from earlier quarters left out, as on Pipeline), per owner role and manager now and when the deal closed, and fiscal quarter, in incremental ARR (USD).

args.q: SELECT Owner.UserRole.Name role, Owner.Manager.Name manager, Closed_Owner_Role__c closedRole, Closed_Owner_Manager__c closedManager, IsClosed closed, IsWon won, FISCAL_YEAR(Actual_Close_Date__c) fy, FISCAL_QUARTER(Actual_Close_Date__c) fq, SUM(Finance_ARR_USD__c) arr, COUNT(Id) n FROM Opportunity WHERE RecordType.Name IN ('New Business','Upsell') AND (IsClosed = false OR IsWon = true OR Closed_Reason__c NOT IN ('Merged with Global Pilot','Record cleanup')) AND ((IsClosed = true AND (Closed_Owner_Role__c IN ('AE-EMEA-FR','AE-EMEA-DACH','AE-EMEA-SOUTH','AE-EMEA-CEE','AE-EMEA-BENELUX','AE-EMEA-MEA','AE-EMEA-IBERIA-LATAM','AE-EMEA-NORDICS','SMB-EMEA','EM-EMEA','EM-EMEA-LATAM','BDR-EMEA','DIR-SALES-EMEA','MGR-SALES-EMEA','VP-SALES-EMEA','DIR-EM-EMEA','DIR-BDR-EMEA') OR Owner.UserRole.Name IN ('AE-EMEA-FR','AE-EMEA-DACH','AE-EMEA-SOUTH','AE-EMEA-CEE','AE-EMEA-BENELUX','AE-EMEA-MEA','AE-EMEA-IBERIA-LATAM','AE-EMEA-NORDICS','SMB-EMEA','EM-EMEA','EM-EMEA-LATAM','BDR-EMEA','DIR-SALES-EMEA','MGR-SALES-EMEA','VP-SALES-EMEA','DIR-EM-EMEA','DIR-BDR-EMEA')) AND (Actual_Close_Date__c = LAST_N_FISCAL_QUARTERS:4 OR Actual_Close_Date__c = THIS_FISCAL_QUARTER)) OR (IsClosed = false AND Owner.UserRole.Name IN ('AE-EMEA-FR','AE-EMEA-DACH','AE-EMEA-SOUTH','AE-EMEA-CEE','AE-EMEA-BENELUX','AE-EMEA-MEA','AE-EMEA-IBERIA-LATAM','AE-EMEA-NORDICS','SMB-EMEA','EM-EMEA','EM-EMEA-LATAM','BDR-EMEA','DIR-SALES-EMEA','MGR-SALES-EMEA','VP-SALES-EMEA','DIR-EM-EMEA','DIR-BDR-EMEA') AND (CloseDate = THIS_FISCAL_QUARTER OR CloseDate = NEXT_FISCAL_QUARTER))) GROUP BY Owner.UserRole.Name, Owner.Manager.Name, Closed_Owner_Role__c, Closed_Owner_Manager__c, IsClosed, IsWon, FISCAL_YEAR(Actual_Close_Date__c), FISCAL_QUARTER(Actual_Close_Date__c) LIMIT 2000

bk_stale.title: Untouched active accounts
bk_stale.description: Active accounts (customer, pipeline, engaging) of EMEA owners with no logged activity in 90 days or ever, per owner and status, with how many were ever touched and how many have an Engagement Manager.

args.q: SELECT Owner.Name owner, Account_Status__c status, COUNT(Id) accounts, COUNT(LastActivityDate) everTouched, COUNT(CSM__c) withEm, SUM(ARR_USD__c) arrUsd FROM Account WHERE Owner.UserRole.Name IN ('AE-EMEA-FR','AE-EMEA-DACH','AE-EMEA-SOUTH','AE-EMEA-CEE','AE-EMEA-BENELUX','AE-EMEA-MEA','AE-EMEA-IBERIA-LATAM','AE-EMEA-NORDICS','SMB-EMEA','EM-EMEA','EM-EMEA-LATAM','BDR-EMEA','DIR-SALES-EMEA','MGR-SALES-EMEA','VP-SALES-EMEA','DIR-EM-EMEA','DIR-BDR-EMEA') AND Account_Status__c IN ('Customer','Pipeline','Engaging') AND (LastActivityDate < LAST_N_DAYS:90 OR LastActivityDate = null) GROUP BY Owner.Name, Account_Status__c LIMIT 2000

bk_em_cover.title: Engagement Manager coverage
bk_em_cover.description: Customers of EMEA owners grouped by their Engagement Manager's role and whether that user is active (blank when there is none), with customer ARR (USD).

args.q: SELECT Owner.Name owner, CSM__r.UserRole.Name emRole, CSM__r.IsActive emActive, COUNT(Id) customers, COUNT(CSM__c) withEm, SUM(ARR_USD__c) arrUsd FROM Account WHERE Owner.UserRole.Name IN ('AE-EMEA-FR','AE-EMEA-DACH','AE-EMEA-SOUTH','AE-EMEA-CEE','AE-EMEA-BENELUX','AE-EMEA-MEA','AE-EMEA-IBERIA-LATAM','AE-EMEA-NORDICS','SMB-EMEA','EM-EMEA','EM-EMEA-LATAM','BDR-EMEA','DIR-SALES-EMEA','MGR-SALES-EMEA','VP-SALES-EMEA','DIR-EM-EMEA','DIR-BDR-EMEA') AND Account_Status__c = 'Customer' GROUP BY Owner.Name, CSM__r.UserRole.Name, CSM__r.IsActive LIMIT 2000

lv_opps.title: Open deals owned by people who left
lv_opps.description: Open opportunities of every type whose owner is an inactive Salesforce user with an EMEA role, per owner and type: how many, incremental ARR and contract ARR (USD), and the next close date.

args.q: SELECT OwnerId ownerId, Owner.Name owner, Owner.UserRole.Name role, Owner.Manager.Name manager, RecordType.Name rt, COUNT(Id) opps, SUM(Finance_ARR_USD__c) arrUsd, SUM(Order_Form_ARR_USD__c) contractArrUsd, MIN(CloseDate) nextClose FROM Opportunity WHERE IsClosed = false AND Owner.IsActive = false AND Owner.UserRole.Name IN ('AE-EMEA-FR','AE-EMEA-DACH','AE-EMEA-SOUTH','AE-EMEA-CEE','AE-EMEA-BENELUX','AE-EMEA-MEA','AE-EMEA-IBERIA-LATAM','AE-EMEA-NORDICS','SMB-EMEA','EM-EMEA','EM-EMEA-LATAM','BDR-EMEA','DIR-SALES-EMEA','MGR-SALES-EMEA','VP-SALES-EMEA','DIR-EM-EMEA','DIR-BDR-EMEA') GROUP BY OwnerId, Owner.Name, Owner.UserRole.Name, Owner.Manager.Name, RecordType.Name LIMIT 2000

lv_leads.title: Open leads owned by people who left
lv_leads.description: Leads that are neither converted nor disqualified whose owner is an inactive Salesforce user with an EMEA role, counted per owner and status.

args.q: SELECT OwnerId ownerId, Status status, COUNT(Id) leads FROM Lead WHERE IsConverted = false AND Status NOT IN ('Disqualified','Converted') AND OwnerId IN (SELECT Id FROM User WHERE IsActive = false AND UserRole.Name IN ('AE-EMEA-FR','AE-EMEA-DACH','AE-EMEA-SOUTH','AE-EMEA-CEE','AE-EMEA-BENELUX','AE-EMEA-MEA','AE-EMEA-IBERIA-LATAM','AE-EMEA-NORDICS','SMB-EMEA','EM-EMEA','EM-EMEA-LATAM','BDR-EMEA','DIR-SALES-EMEA','MGR-SALES-EMEA','VP-SALES-EMEA','DIR-EM-EMEA','DIR-BDR-EMEA')) GROUP BY OwnerId, Status LIMIT 2000

ld_ready.title: Ready leads now
ld_ready.description: Leads in Ready now (not converted) that an EMEA seller owns, or that are EMEA by country or LeanData routing region (LATAM included) whoever owns them (the Marketing Queue, other teams). Grouped per owner, LeanData routing region and sub-region, lead source and detail, and the UTC day they became Ready, with the earliest created date. Counts only.

args.q: SELECT OwnerId ownerId, Owner.Name owner, Owner.Type ownerType, Owner.UserRole.Name ownerRole, Owner.IsActive ownerActive, Routing_Region__c routingRegion, Routing_Sub_Region__c routingSub, LeadSource src, Lead_Source_Details__c detail, DAY_ONLY(Ready_Since__c) readyDay, COUNT(Id) leads, MIN(CreatedDate) firstCreated FROM Lead WHERE Status = 'Ready' AND IsConverted = false AND (Owner.UserRole.Name IN ('AE-EMEA-FR','AE-EMEA-DACH','AE-EMEA-SOUTH','AE-EMEA-CEE','AE-EMEA-BENELUX','AE-EMEA-MEA','AE-EMEA-IBERIA-LATAM','AE-EMEA-NORDICS','SMB-EMEA','EM-EMEA','EM-EMEA-LATAM','BDR-EMEA','DIR-SALES-EMEA','MGR-SALES-EMEA','VP-SALES-EMEA','DIR-EM-EMEA','DIR-BDR-EMEA') OR Region__c = 'EMEA' OR Routing_Region__c = 'EMEA' OR Routing_Sub_Region__c = 'LATAM') GROUP BY OwnerId, Owner.Name, Owner.Type, Owner.UserRole.Name, Owner.IsActive, Routing_Region__c, Routing_Sub_Region__c, LeadSource, Lead_Source_Details__c, DAY_ONLY(Ready_Since__c) LIMIT 2000

ld_handoffs.title: Lead hand-offs, last 30 days
ld_handoffs.description: Leads in scope whose Ready Since stamp is in the last 30 days, one row per lead but without its Id or any prospect detail: current owner (type, role, active), lead source and detail, status, converted flag, and the exact Ready Since, First Response and Last Routed (LeanData, to a person) times.

args.q: SELECT OwnerId ownerId, Owner.Type ownerType, Owner.Name owner, Owner.UserRole.Name ownerRole, Owner.IsActive ownerActive, LeadSource src, Lead_Source_Details__c detail, Status status, IsConverted converted, MIN(Ready_Since__c) readyAt, MIN(First_Response_Timestamp__c) respAt, MIN(Last_Assigned_Date__c) routedAt FROM Lead WHERE Ready_Since__c = LAST_N_DAYS:30 AND (Owner.UserRole.Name IN ('AE-EMEA-FR','AE-EMEA-DACH','AE-EMEA-SOUTH','AE-EMEA-CEE','AE-EMEA-BENELUX','AE-EMEA-MEA','AE-EMEA-IBERIA-LATAM','AE-EMEA-NORDICS','SMB-EMEA','EM-EMEA','EM-EMEA-LATAM','BDR-EMEA','DIR-SALES-EMEA','MGR-SALES-EMEA','VP-SALES-EMEA','DIR-EM-EMEA','DIR-BDR-EMEA') OR Region__c = 'EMEA' OR Routing_Region__c = 'EMEA' OR Routing_Sub_Region__c = 'LATAM') GROUP BY Id, OwnerId, Owner.Type, Owner.Name, Owner.UserRole.Name, Owner.IsActive, LeadSource, Lead_Source_Details__c, Status, IsConverted ORDER BY MIN(Ready_Since__c) DESC LIMIT 2000

ld_inflow.title: Leads created, last 30 days
ld_inflow.description: Leads in scope created in the last 30 days, by lead source and detail, owner type and role, LeanData routing sub-region, status and LeanData routing action, with how many were stamped Ready and how many LeanData routed to a person (Last Routed Date). Counts only.

args.q: SELECT LeadSource src, Lead_Source_Details__c detail, Owner.Type ownerType, Owner.UserRole.Name ownerRole, Routing_Sub_Region__c subRegion, Status status, LeanData__Routing_Action__c routing, COUNT(Id) leads, COUNT(Ready_Since__c) readyStamped, COUNT(Last_Assigned_Date__c) routedToPerson FROM Lead WHERE CreatedDate = LAST_N_DAYS:30 AND (Owner.UserRole.Name IN ('AE-EMEA-FR','AE-EMEA-DACH','AE-EMEA-SOUTH','AE-EMEA-CEE','AE-EMEA-BENELUX','AE-EMEA-MEA','AE-EMEA-IBERIA-LATAM','AE-EMEA-NORDICS','SMB-EMEA','EM-EMEA','EM-EMEA-LATAM','BDR-EMEA','DIR-SALES-EMEA','MGR-SALES-EMEA','VP-SALES-EMEA','DIR-EM-EMEA','DIR-BDR-EMEA') OR Region__c = 'EMEA' OR Routing_Region__c = 'EMEA' OR Routing_Sub_Region__c = 'LATAM') GROUP BY LeadSource, Lead_Source_Details__c, Owner.Type, Owner.UserRole.Name, Routing_Sub_Region__c, Status, LeanData__Routing_Action__c LIMIT 2000

ld_open.title: Open leads per owner
ld_open.description: Open leads in scope (neither converted nor disqualified) per owner (a person or a queue), owner role and active flag, status, lifecycle stage and LeanData routing status and action, with how many and when LeanData last processed one of them. Counts only.

args.q: SELECT OwnerId ownerId, Owner.Type ownerType, Owner.Name owner, Owner.UserRole.Name ownerRole, Owner.IsActive ownerActive, Status status, Lifecycle_Stage__c lifecycle, LeanData__Routing_Status__c ldStatus, LeanData__Routing_Action__c ldAction, COUNT(Id) leads, MAX(LeanData__Reporting_Timestamp__c) lastProcessed FROM Lead WHERE IsConverted = false AND Status NOT IN ('Disqualified','Converted') AND (Owner.UserRole.Name IN ('AE-EMEA-FR','AE-EMEA-DACH','AE-EMEA-SOUTH','AE-EMEA-CEE','AE-EMEA-BENELUX','AE-EMEA-MEA','AE-EMEA-IBERIA-LATAM','AE-EMEA-NORDICS','SMB-EMEA','EM-EMEA','EM-EMEA-LATAM','BDR-EMEA','DIR-SALES-EMEA','MGR-SALES-EMEA','VP-SALES-EMEA','DIR-EM-EMEA','DIR-BDR-EMEA') OR Region__c = 'EMEA' OR Routing_Region__c = 'EMEA' OR Routing_Sub_Region__c = 'LATAM') GROUP BY OwnerId, Owner.Type, Owner.Name, Owner.UserRole.Name, Owner.IsActive, Status, Lifecycle_Stage__c, LeanData__Routing_Status__c, LeanData__Routing_Action__c LIMIT 2000

act_mail.title: Emails sent, last 4 weeks
act_mail.description: Emails EMEA sellers sent in the 28 days to yesterday (by the email's date), as Einstein Activity Capture copied them from their mailbox (Outreach sends included): email tasks with a sent, not incoming, Email Message. Per owner and the account's status today: emails, distinct people and accounts emailed, and when the last one was captured. Received mail, Outreach's own email log (it repeats the mailbox copy and logs prospect replies as outbound), automation emails with no captured message and RevOps admin tasks are left out. Counts only.

args.q: SELECT Owner.Name owner, Owner.UserRole.Name role, Account.Account_Status__c acct, COUNT(Id) emails, COUNT_DISTINCT(WhoId) people, COUNT_DISTINCT(AccountId) accounts, MAX(CreatedDate) lastAt FROM Task WHERE TaskSubtype = 'Email' AND Id IN (SELECT ActivityId FROM EmailMessage WHERE Incoming = false AND CreatedDate = LAST_N_DAYS:35) AND ActivityDate = LAST_N_DAYS:28 AND ActivityDate < TODAY AND Owner.UserRole.Name IN ('AE-EMEA-FR','AE-EMEA-DACH','AE-EMEA-SOUTH','AE-EMEA-CEE','AE-EMEA-BENELUX','AE-EMEA-MEA','AE-EMEA-IBERIA-LATAM','AE-EMEA-NORDICS','SMB-EMEA','EM-EMEA','EM-EMEA-LATAM','BDR-EMEA','DIR-SALES-EMEA','MGR-SALES-EMEA','VP-SALES-EMEA','DIR-EM-EMEA','DIR-BDR-EMEA') GROUP BY Owner.Name, Owner.UserRole.Name, Account.Account_Status__c LIMIT 2000

act_mail_prev.title: Emails sent, the 4 weeks before
act_mail_prev.description: The same sent emails dated 29 to 56 days ago, per owner and account status, with the first and last capture time, so the page can tell whether capture covered the whole earlier window. Counts only.

args.q: SELECT Owner.Name owner, Owner.UserRole.Name role, Account.Account_Status__c acct, COUNT(Id) emails, COUNT_DISTINCT(WhoId) people, COUNT_DISTINCT(AccountId) accounts, MIN(CreatedDate) firstAt, MAX(CreatedDate) lastAt FROM Task WHERE TaskSubtype = 'Email' AND Id IN (SELECT ActivityId FROM EmailMessage WHERE Incoming = false AND CreatedDate = LAST_N_DAYS:63) AND ActivityDate = LAST_N_DAYS:56 AND ActivityDate < LAST_N_DAYS:28 AND Owner.UserRole.Name IN ('AE-EMEA-FR','AE-EMEA-DACH','AE-EMEA-SOUTH','AE-EMEA-CEE','AE-EMEA-BENELUX','AE-EMEA-MEA','AE-EMEA-IBERIA-LATAM','AE-EMEA-NORDICS','SMB-EMEA','EM-EMEA','EM-EMEA-LATAM','BDR-EMEA','DIR-SALES-EMEA','MGR-SALES-EMEA','VP-SALES-EMEA','DIR-EM-EMEA','DIR-BDR-EMEA') GROUP BY Owner.Name, Owner.UserRole.Name, Account.Account_Status__c LIMIT 2000

act_meet.title: Meetings, last 4 weeks and next 2
act_meet.description: Calendar records of EMEA sellers with a contact, lead or account (not Legora's own), not all-day, that started in the 28 days to yesterday (past = true) or start in the 14 days from tomorrow (past = false). Per owner, past or booked, and the account's status: records, meetings (distinct start times), distinct accounts and people, and the first and last start. LeanData BookIt meetings marked Canceled or Rescheduled are left out. Counts only.

args.q: SELECT Owner.Name owner, Owner.UserRole.Name role, Activity_in_Past__c past, Account.Account_Status__c acct, COUNT(Id) events, COUNT_DISTINCT(StartDateTime) meetings, COUNT_DISTINCT(AccountId) accounts, COUNT_DISTINCT(WhoId) people, MIN(StartDateTime) firstAt, MAX(StartDateTime) lastAt FROM Event WHERE ((StartDateTime = LAST_N_DAYS:28 AND StartDateTime < TODAY) OR StartDateTime = NEXT_N_DAYS:14) AND IsAllDayEvent = false AND (WhoId != null OR AccountId != null) AND (NOT Account.Name LIKE 'Legora%') AND (BookIt_Meeting_Status__c = null OR BookIt_Meeting_Status__c NOT IN ('Canceled','Rescheduled')) AND Owner.UserRole.Name IN ('AE-EMEA-FR','AE-EMEA-DACH','AE-EMEA-SOUTH','AE-EMEA-CEE','AE-EMEA-BENELUX','AE-EMEA-MEA','AE-EMEA-IBERIA-LATAM','AE-EMEA-NORDICS','SMB-EMEA','EM-EMEA','EM-EMEA-LATAM','BDR-EMEA','DIR-SALES-EMEA','MGR-SALES-EMEA','VP-SALES-EMEA','DIR-EM-EMEA','DIR-BDR-EMEA') GROUP BY Owner.Name, Owner.UserRole.Name, Activity_in_Past__c, Account.Account_Status__c LIMIT 2000

act_meet_prev.title: Meetings, the 4 weeks before
act_meet_prev.description: The same meetings that started 29 to 56 days ago, per owner and account status, with the first and last start, so the page can tell whether calendar capture covered the whole earlier window. Counts only.

args.q: SELECT Owner.Name owner, Owner.UserRole.Name role, Account.Account_Status__c acct, COUNT(Id) events, COUNT_DISTINCT(StartDateTime) meetings, COUNT_DISTINCT(AccountId) accounts, COUNT_DISTINCT(WhoId) people, MIN(StartDateTime) firstAt, MAX(StartDateTime) lastAt FROM Event WHERE StartDateTime = LAST_N_DAYS:56 AND StartDateTime < LAST_N_DAYS:28 AND IsAllDayEvent = false AND (WhoId != null OR AccountId != null) AND (NOT Account.Name LIKE 'Legora%') AND (BookIt_Meeting_Status__c = null OR BookIt_Meeting_Status__c NOT IN ('Canceled','Rescheduled')) AND Owner.UserRole.Name IN ('AE-EMEA-FR','AE-EMEA-DACH','AE-EMEA-SOUTH','AE-EMEA-CEE','AE-EMEA-BENELUX','AE-EMEA-MEA','AE-EMEA-IBERIA-LATAM','AE-EMEA-NORDICS','SMB-EMEA','EM-EMEA','EM-EMEA-LATAM','BDR-EMEA','DIR-SALES-EMEA','MGR-SALES-EMEA','VP-SALES-EMEA','DIR-EM-EMEA','DIR-BDR-EMEA') GROUP BY Owner.Name, Owner.UserRole.Name, Account.Account_Status__c LIMIT 2000

cv_open.title: Open opps by created quarter
cv_open.description: Open EMEA New Business and Upsell opportunities of any age, by type, the quarter they were created in (in your Salesforce time zone), owner role and the owner's manager: how many, their incremental ARR (USD), how many carry each stage entry date (stage 0 to 6; a skipped stage is dated too) and how many were marked Closed Won or Closed Lost before and reopened. Counts and sums only.

args.q: SELECT RecordType.Name rt, FISCAL_YEAR(convertTimezone(CreatedDate)) fy, FISCAL_QUARTER(convertTimezone(CreatedDate)) fq, Owner.UserRole.Name role, Owner.Manager.Name manager, COUNT(Id) n, SUM(Finance_ARR_USD__c) arr, COUNT(IRO_Stage_0_Date_Stamp__c) s0, COUNT(IRO_Stage_1_Date_Stamp__c) s1, COUNT(IRO_Stage_2_Date_Stamp__c) s2, COUNT(IRO_Stage_3_Date_Stamp__c) s3, COUNT(IRO_Stage_4_Date_Stamp__c) s4, COUNT(IRO_Stage_5_Date_Stamp__c) s5, COUNT(IRO_Stage_6_Date_Stamp__c) s6, COUNT(IRO_Closed_Won_Date_Stamp__c) cwStamp, COUNT(IRO_Closed_Lost_Date_Stamp__c) clStamp FROM Opportunity WHERE RecordType.Name IN ('New Business','Upsell') AND Owner.UserRole.Name IN ('AE-EMEA-FR','AE-EMEA-DACH','AE-EMEA-SOUTH','AE-EMEA-CEE','AE-EMEA-BENELUX','AE-EMEA-MEA','AE-EMEA-IBERIA-LATAM','AE-EMEA-NORDICS','SMB-EMEA','EM-EMEA','EM-EMEA-LATAM','BDR-EMEA','DIR-SALES-EMEA','MGR-SALES-EMEA','VP-SALES-EMEA','DIR-EM-EMEA','DIR-BDR-EMEA') AND IsClosed = false GROUP BY RecordType.Name, FISCAL_YEAR(convertTimezone(CreatedDate)), FISCAL_QUARTER(convertTimezone(CreatedDate)), Owner.UserRole.Name, Owner.Manager.Name LIMIT 2000

cv_closed.title: Won and lost opps by created quarter
cv_closed.description: EMEA New Business and Upsell opportunities created in the last 4 completed quarters and this one (in your Salesforce time zone) that are now closed won or lost, admin merges ('Merged with Global Pilot', 'Record cleanup') left out, with the owner's role and manager now and when the deal closed (a deal counts for the team that closed it, also when it is owned outside EMEA today), won or lost, and the quarter it was actually closed (Actual Close Date): how many, their incremental ARR (USD), how many carry each stage entry date (0 to 6) and the Closed Won and Closed Lost entry dates. Counts and sums only.

args.q: SELECT RecordType.Name rt, FISCAL_YEAR(convertTimezone(CreatedDate)) fy, FISCAL_QUARTER(convertTimezone(CreatedDate)) fq, Owner.UserRole.Name role, Owner.Manager.Name manager, Closed_Owner_Role__c closedRole, Closed_Owner_Manager__c closedManager, IsWon won, FISCAL_YEAR(Actual_Close_Date__c) cfy, FISCAL_QUARTER(Actual_Close_Date__c) cfq, COUNT(Id) n, SUM(Finance_ARR_USD__c) arr, COUNT(IRO_Stage_0_Date_Stamp__c) s0, COUNT(IRO_Stage_1_Date_Stamp__c) s1, COUNT(IRO_Stage_2_Date_Stamp__c) s2, COUNT(IRO_Stage_3_Date_Stamp__c) s3, COUNT(IRO_Stage_4_Date_Stamp__c) s4, COUNT(IRO_Stage_5_Date_Stamp__c) s5, COUNT(IRO_Stage_6_Date_Stamp__c) s6, COUNT(IRO_Closed_Won_Date_Stamp__c) cwStamp, COUNT(IRO_Closed_Lost_Date_Stamp__c) clStamp FROM Opportunity WHERE RecordType.Name IN ('New Business','Upsell') AND (Closed_Owner_Role__c IN ('AE-EMEA-FR','AE-EMEA-DACH','AE-EMEA-SOUTH','AE-EMEA-CEE','AE-EMEA-BENELUX','AE-EMEA-MEA','AE-EMEA-IBERIA-LATAM','AE-EMEA-NORDICS','SMB-EMEA','EM-EMEA','EM-EMEA-LATAM','BDR-EMEA','DIR-SALES-EMEA','MGR-SALES-EMEA','VP-SALES-EMEA','DIR-EM-EMEA','DIR-BDR-EMEA') OR Owner.UserRole.Name IN ('AE-EMEA-FR','AE-EMEA-DACH','AE-EMEA-SOUTH','AE-EMEA-CEE','AE-EMEA-BENELUX','AE-EMEA-MEA','AE-EMEA-IBERIA-LATAM','AE-EMEA-NORDICS','SMB-EMEA','EM-EMEA','EM-EMEA-LATAM','BDR-EMEA','DIR-SALES-EMEA','MGR-SALES-EMEA','VP-SALES-EMEA','DIR-EM-EMEA','DIR-BDR-EMEA')) AND IsClosed = true AND (CreatedDate = LAST_N_FISCAL_QUARTERS:4 OR CreatedDate = THIS_FISCAL_QUARTER) AND (IsWon = true OR Closed_Reason__c = null OR Closed_Reason__c NOT IN ('Merged with Global Pilot','Record cleanup')) GROUP BY RecordType.Name, FISCAL_YEAR(convertTimezone(CreatedDate)), FISCAL_QUARTER(convertTimezone(CreatedDate)), Owner.UserRole.Name, Owner.Manager.Name, Closed_Owner_Role__c, Closed_Owner_Manager__c, IsWon, FISCAL_YEAR(Actual_Close_Date__c), FISCAL_QUARTER(Actual_Close_Date__c) LIMIT 2000

cv_window.title: New Business closed, last 4 quarters
cv_window.description: EMEA New Business closed won or lost in the last 4 completed quarters and this one, by the date it was actually closed, for the team that closed it (also when it is owned outside EMEA today): by close quarter, owner role now and when the deal closed, won or lost, the last stage before close and the lost reason (the list retired on 3 Nov 2026 and the new one): how many and their incremental ARR (USD). Admin merges are kept so they can be counted, and left out of every figure. Counts and sums only.

args.q: SELECT FISCAL_YEAR(Actual_Close_Date__c) fy, FISCAL_QUARTER(Actual_Close_Date__c) fq, Owner.UserRole.Name role, Closed_Owner_Role__c closedRole, IsWon won, IRO_Last_Stage_Before_Close__c lastStage, Closed_Reason__c reason, COUNT(Id) n, SUM(Finance_ARR_USD__c) arr FROM Opportunity WHERE RecordType.Name = 'New Business' AND (Closed_Owner_Role__c IN ('AE-EMEA-FR','AE-EMEA-DACH','AE-EMEA-SOUTH','AE-EMEA-CEE','AE-EMEA-BENELUX','AE-EMEA-MEA','AE-EMEA-IBERIA-LATAM','AE-EMEA-NORDICS','SMB-EMEA','EM-EMEA','EM-EMEA-LATAM','BDR-EMEA','DIR-SALES-EMEA','MGR-SALES-EMEA','VP-SALES-EMEA','DIR-EM-EMEA','DIR-BDR-EMEA') OR Owner.UserRole.Name IN ('AE-EMEA-FR','AE-EMEA-DACH','AE-EMEA-SOUTH','AE-EMEA-CEE','AE-EMEA-BENELUX','AE-EMEA-MEA','AE-EMEA-IBERIA-LATAM','AE-EMEA-NORDICS','SMB-EMEA','EM-EMEA','EM-EMEA-LATAM','BDR-EMEA','DIR-SALES-EMEA','MGR-SALES-EMEA','VP-SALES-EMEA','DIR-EM-EMEA','DIR-BDR-EMEA')) AND IsClosed = true AND (Actual_Close_Date__c = LAST_N_FISCAL_QUARTERS:4 OR Actual_Close_Date__c = THIS_FISCAL_QUARTER) GROUP BY FISCAL_YEAR(Actual_Close_Date__c), FISCAL_QUARTER(Actual_Close_Date__c), Owner.UserRole.Name, Closed_Owner_Role__c, IsWon, IRO_Last_Stage_Before_Close__c, Closed_Reason__c LIMIT 2000

cv_lost_month.title: New Business lost by month
cv_lost_month.description: EMEA New Business closed lost in the last 4 completed quarters and this one, for the team that closed it, admin merges left out: how many per calendar month of the date actually closed. It finds a one-month burst of losses, such as a pipeline clean-up. Counts only.

args.q: SELECT CALENDAR_YEAR(Actual_Close_Date__c) yr, CALENDAR_MONTH(Actual_Close_Date__c) mo, COUNT(Id) n FROM Opportunity WHERE RecordType.Name = 'New Business' AND (Closed_Owner_Role__c IN ('AE-EMEA-FR','AE-EMEA-DACH','AE-EMEA-SOUTH','AE-EMEA-CEE','AE-EMEA-BENELUX','AE-EMEA-MEA','AE-EMEA-IBERIA-LATAM','AE-EMEA-NORDICS','SMB-EMEA','EM-EMEA','EM-EMEA-LATAM','BDR-EMEA','DIR-SALES-EMEA','MGR-SALES-EMEA','VP-SALES-EMEA','DIR-EM-EMEA','DIR-BDR-EMEA') OR Owner.UserRole.Name IN ('AE-EMEA-FR','AE-EMEA-DACH','AE-EMEA-SOUTH','AE-EMEA-CEE','AE-EMEA-BENELUX','AE-EMEA-MEA','AE-EMEA-IBERIA-LATAM','AE-EMEA-NORDICS','SMB-EMEA','EM-EMEA','EM-EMEA-LATAM','BDR-EMEA','DIR-SALES-EMEA','MGR-SALES-EMEA','VP-SALES-EMEA','DIR-EM-EMEA','DIR-BDR-EMEA')) AND IsClosed = true AND IsWon = false AND (Actual_Close_Date__c = LAST_N_FISCAL_QUARTERS:4 OR Actual_Close_Date__c = THIS_FISCAL_QUARTER) AND (Closed_Reason__c = null OR Closed_Reason__c NOT IN ('Merged with Global Pilot','Record cleanup')) GROUP BY CALENDAR_YEAR(Actual_Close_Date__c), CALENDAR_MONTH(Actual_Close_Date__c) LIMIT 2000

cv_source.title: New Business by source
cv_source.description: EMEA New Business closed won or lost in the last 4 completed quarters (by the date actually closed; admin merges left out; for the team that closed it), plus every open one an EMEA role owns, by lead source, the originating BDR's role (stamped on the deal, and the BDR's role today), the creator's role, owner role now and when the deal closed, open or closed, and won or lost: how many, incremental ARR (USD), and the days from creation to the close date added up, with how many deals had them. Counts and sums only.

args.q: SELECT LeadSource src, Originating_BDR_Role__c bdrRole, Originating_BDR__r.UserRole.Name bdrNow, CreatedBy.UserRole.Name creatorRole, Owner.UserRole.Name role, Closed_Owner_Role__c closedRole, IsClosed closed, IsWon won, COUNT(Id) n, SUM(Finance_ARR_USD__c) arr, SUM(Days_from_Created_to_Close_Date__c) cycleDays, COUNT(Days_from_Created_to_Close_Date__c) cycleN FROM Opportunity WHERE RecordType.Name = 'New Business' AND ((IsClosed = false AND Owner.UserRole.Name IN ('AE-EMEA-FR','AE-EMEA-DACH','AE-EMEA-SOUTH','AE-EMEA-CEE','AE-EMEA-BENELUX','AE-EMEA-MEA','AE-EMEA-IBERIA-LATAM','AE-EMEA-NORDICS','SMB-EMEA','EM-EMEA','EM-EMEA-LATAM','BDR-EMEA','DIR-SALES-EMEA','MGR-SALES-EMEA','VP-SALES-EMEA','DIR-EM-EMEA','DIR-BDR-EMEA')) OR (IsClosed = true AND (Closed_Owner_Role__c IN ('AE-EMEA-FR','AE-EMEA-DACH','AE-EMEA-SOUTH','AE-EMEA-CEE','AE-EMEA-BENELUX','AE-EMEA-MEA','AE-EMEA-IBERIA-LATAM','AE-EMEA-NORDICS','SMB-EMEA','EM-EMEA','EM-EMEA-LATAM','BDR-EMEA','DIR-SALES-EMEA','MGR-SALES-EMEA','VP-SALES-EMEA','DIR-EM-EMEA','DIR-BDR-EMEA') OR Owner.UserRole.Name IN ('AE-EMEA-FR','AE-EMEA-DACH','AE-EMEA-SOUTH','AE-EMEA-CEE','AE-EMEA-BENELUX','AE-EMEA-MEA','AE-EMEA-IBERIA-LATAM','AE-EMEA-NORDICS','SMB-EMEA','EM-EMEA','EM-EMEA-LATAM','BDR-EMEA','DIR-SALES-EMEA','MGR-SALES-EMEA','VP-SALES-EMEA','DIR-EM-EMEA','DIR-BDR-EMEA')) AND Actual_Close_Date__c = LAST_N_FISCAL_QUARTERS:4 AND (IsWon = true OR Closed_Reason__c = null OR Closed_Reason__c NOT IN ('Merged with Global Pilot','Record cleanup')))) GROUP BY LeadSource, Originating_BDR_Role__c, Originating_BDR__r.UserRole.Name, CreatedBy.UserRole.Name, Owner.UserRole.Name, Closed_Owner_Role__c, IsClosed, IsWon LIMIT 2000

cv_days.title: Days in each stage of recent wins
cv_days.description: EMEA New Business won in the last 90 days (deals SMB closed: the last 30 days), for the team that closed it, one row per deal but without its Id, name, account or ARR: owner role and the owner's manager now and when the deal closed, the days the deal spent in each stage 0 to 6 (from one stage entry date to the next; 0 for a stage passed the same day or skipped), the days from creation to the win, and its Closed Won entry date and close date (to spot wins reopened and won again).

args.q: SELECT Owner.UserRole.Name role, Owner.Manager.Name manager, Closed_Owner_Role__c closedRole, Closed_Owner_Manager__c closedManager, MAX(Days_in_Stage_0__c) d0, MAX(Days_in_Stage_1__c) d1, MAX(Days_in_Stage_2__c) d2, MAX(Days_in_Stage_3__c) d3, MAX(Days_in_Stage_4__c) d4, MAX(Days_in_Stage_5__c) d5, MAX(Days_in_Stage_6__c) d6, MAX(Days_from_Created_to_Close_Date__c) daysToWin, MAX(IRO_Closed_Won_Date_Stamp__c) cwAt, MAX(Actual_Close_Date__c) closeAt FROM Opportunity WHERE RecordType.Name = 'New Business' AND (Closed_Owner_Role__c IN ('AE-EMEA-FR','AE-EMEA-DACH','AE-EMEA-SOUTH','AE-EMEA-CEE','AE-EMEA-BENELUX','AE-EMEA-MEA','AE-EMEA-IBERIA-LATAM','AE-EMEA-NORDICS','SMB-EMEA','EM-EMEA','EM-EMEA-LATAM','BDR-EMEA','DIR-SALES-EMEA','MGR-SALES-EMEA','VP-SALES-EMEA','DIR-EM-EMEA','DIR-BDR-EMEA') OR Owner.UserRole.Name IN ('AE-EMEA-FR','AE-EMEA-DACH','AE-EMEA-SOUTH','AE-EMEA-CEE','AE-EMEA-BENELUX','AE-EMEA-MEA','AE-EMEA-IBERIA-LATAM','AE-EMEA-NORDICS','SMB-EMEA','EM-EMEA','EM-EMEA-LATAM','BDR-EMEA','DIR-SALES-EMEA','MGR-SALES-EMEA','VP-SALES-EMEA','DIR-EM-EMEA','DIR-BDR-EMEA')) AND IsWon = true AND Actual_Close_Date__c = LAST_N_DAYS:90 AND ((Closed_Owner_Role__c != 'SMB-EMEA' AND (Closed_Owner_Role__c IN ('AE-EMEA-FR','AE-EMEA-DACH','AE-EMEA-SOUTH','AE-EMEA-CEE','AE-EMEA-BENELUX','AE-EMEA-MEA','AE-EMEA-IBERIA-LATAM','AE-EMEA-NORDICS','SMB-EMEA','EM-EMEA','EM-EMEA-LATAM','BDR-EMEA','DIR-SALES-EMEA','MGR-SALES-EMEA','VP-SALES-EMEA','DIR-EM-EMEA','DIR-BDR-EMEA') OR Owner.UserRole.Name != 'SMB-EMEA')) OR Actual_Close_Date__c = LAST_N_DAYS:30) GROUP BY Id, Owner.UserRole.Name, Owner.Manager.Name, Closed_Owner_Role__c, Closed_Owner_Manager__c LIMIT 2000
